##### แปลงค่า Non-Numeric
```{r include=FALSE}
bank <- read.csv("BankChurners.csv")

bank <- bank[,c(2:8, 10:14, 21)]
bank$Attrition_Flag <- factor(bank$Attrition_Flag, levels = c("Attrited Customer", "Existing Customer"))

str(bank)
Attrition_Flag <- bank$Attrition_Flag
bank <- model.matrix(Attrition_Flag~., data = bank)[,-1]
bank <- data.frame(Attrition_Flag, bank)
```

```{r}
dim(bank)
table(bank$Attrition_Flag)
```

#### Smote 75% (ไม่ 100% เพราะ ป้องกัน Overfitting)
```{r}
library(performanceEstimation)
bank <- smote(Attrition_Flag~., data = bank, perc.over = 3.45, perc.under = 1.75)

dim(bank)
table(bank$Attrition_Flag)
```

#Model 1
##Logistic Regession with Monte Cross-Validation

```{r include=FALSE}

logis_acc = seq(20)
logis_tp = seq(20)
logis_tn = seq(20)
logis_fp = seq(20)
logis_fn = seq(20)
logis_pre = seq(20)
logis_rec = seq(20)
logis_f1 = seq(20)

for (i in 1:20){
  train <- sample(dim(bank)[1], size = (0.8*dim(bank)[1]), replace = FALSE)
  logis <- glm(Attrition_Flag~.,data = bank, subset = train, family = 'binomial')
  prob <- predict.glm(logis, newdata = bank[-train,], type = "response")
  pred <- rep("Attrited Customer", length(prob))
  pred[prob > median(prob)] = "Existing Customer"
  logis_acc[i] <- mean(bank[-train, ]$Attrition_Flag == pred)
  logis_table <- table(pred, bank[-train, ]$Attrition_Flag)
  logis_tp[i] <- logis_table[1,1]
  logis_tn[i] <- logis_table[2,2]
  logis_fp[i] <- logis_table[1,2]
  logis_fn[i] <- logis_table[2,1]
  logis_pre[i] <- logis_tp[i]/(logis_tp[i] + logis_fp[i])
  logis_rec[i] <- logis_tp[i]/(logis_tp[i] + logis_fn[i])
  logis_f1[i] <- 2*logis_pre[i]*logis_rec[i]/(logis_pre[i] + logis_rec[i])
}

avg_acc <- mean(logis_acc)
avg_tp <- mean(logis_tp)
avg_tn <- mean(logis_tn)
avg_fp <- mean(logis_fp)
avg_fn <- mean(logis_fn)

avg_table <- matrix(c(avg_tp, avg_fp, avg_fn, avg_tn), byrow = TRUE, ncol = 2)
colnames(avg_table) <- c("Attrited Customer", "Existing Customer")
rownames(avg_table) <- c("Pred Attrited Customer", "Pred Existing Customer")

avg_pre <- mean(logis_pre)
avg_rec <- mean(logis_rec)
avg_f1 <- mean(logis_f1)

library(ROSE)
logis_auc <- roc.curve(bank$Attrition_Flag[-train], pred)$auc
```

```{r}
avg_table
```

```{r}
avg_acc
avg_pre
avg_rec
avg_f1

library(ROSE)
roc.curve(bank$Attrition_Flag[-train], pred)
```

# Model 2
## เทียบ forward backward hybrid จาก rss
```{r include=FALSE}
library(leaps)
library(tictoc)
library(boot)


forward=regsubsets(Attrition_Flag~.,data=bank,nvmax = dim(bank)[2], method = "forward")
backward=regsubsets(Attrition_Flag~.,data=bank,nvmax = dim(bank)[2], method = "backward")
hybrid=regsubsets(Attrition_Flag~.,data=bank,nvmax = dim(bank)[2], method = "seqrep")


forward_summary <- summary(forward)
backward_summary <- summary(backward)
hybrid_summary <- summary(hybrid)

varia_select <- matrix(c("Forward", "Backward", "Hybrid", 
                         which.min(forward_summary$rss),which.min(backward_summary$rss),which.min(hybrid_summary$rss)),
                       ncol = 2, byrow = FALSE)
colnames(varia_select) <- c("Method", "number of variable")

```

### จำนวนตัวแปรที่ให้ ค่า rss น้อยสุด ของแต่ละ method
```{r}
varia_select
```


### เลือกใช้ hybrid method เพื่อความหยืดหยุ่นกับชุดข้อมูล
```{r include=FALSE}
hyb_acc <- 1:20
hyb_pre <- 1:20
hyb_rec <- 1:20
hyb_f1 <- 1:20

hyb_tp = seq(20)
hyb_tn = seq(20)
hyb_fp = seq(20)
hyb_fn = seq(20)


for (i in 1:20){
  train <- sample(dim(bank)[1], size = (0.8*dim(bank)[1]), replace = FALSE)
  hyb_variable <- hybrid_summary$which[which.min(hybrid_summary$rss), ]

  hyb_mod <- glm(Attrition_Flag~., data = bank[ ,hyb_variable], subset = train, family = "binomial" )
  hyb_prob <- predict(hyb_mod, newdata= bank[-train,], type = "response")
  hyb_pred <- rep("Attrited Customer", length(hyb_prob))
  hyb_pred[hyb_prob > median(hyb_prob)] = "Existing Customer"
  hyb_acc[i] <- mean(bank[-train, ]$Attrition_Flag == hyb_pred)
  hyb_table <- table(hyb_pred, bank[-train, ]$Attrition_Flag)
  hyb_tp[i] <- hyb_table[1,1]
  hyb_tn[i] <- hyb_table[2,2]
  hyb_fp[i] <- hyb_table[1,2]
  hyb_fn[i] <- hyb_table[2,1]
  hyb_pre[i] <- hyb_tp[i]/(hyb_tp[i] + hyb_fp[i])
  hyb_rec[i] <- hyb_tp[i]/(hyb_tp[i] + hyb_fn[i])
  hyb_f1[i] <- 2*hyb_pre[i]*hyb_rec[i]/(hyb_pre[i] + hyb_rec[i])
}

avg_hyb_tp <- mean(hyb_tp)
avg_hyb_tn <- mean(hyb_tn)
avg_hyb_fp <- mean(hyb_fp)
avg_hyb_fn <- mean(hyb_fn)

avg_hyb_table <- matrix(c(avg_hyb_tp, avg_hyb_fp, avg_hyb_fn, avg_hyb_tn), byrow = TRUE, ncol = 2)
colnames(avg_hyb_table) <- c("Attrited Customer", "Existing Customer")
rownames(avg_hyb_table) <- c("Pred Attrited Customer", "Pred Existing Customer")


avg_hyb_acc <- mean(hyb_acc)
avg_hyb_pre <- mean(hyb_pre)
avg_hyb_rec <- mean(hyb_rec)
avg_hyb_f1 <- mean(hyb_f1)

hyb_auc <- roc.curve(bank$Attrition_Flag[-train], hyb_pred)$auc
```

```{r}
avg_hyb_table
avg_hyb_acc
avg_hyb_pre
avg_hyb_rec
avg_hyb_f1

roc.curve(bank[-train,]$Attrition_Flag, hyb_pred)
```

# Model 3
## PCA 
```{r include=FALSE}
bank <- read.csv("BankChurners.csv")

bank <- bank[,c(2:8, 10:14, 21)]
bank$Attrition_Flag <- factor(bank$Attrition_Flag, levels = c("Attrited Customer", "Existing Customer"))

str(bank)
Attrition_Flag <- bank$Attrition_Flag
bank <- model.matrix(Attrition_Flag~., data = bank)[,-1]
bank <- data.frame(Attrition_Flag, bank)

pca <- prcomp(bank[,-1], scale = TRUE)
pca_var <- (pca$sdev)^2
pca_var_ratio <- pca_var/sum(pca_var)
#plot(pca_var_ratio)

cumu_var <- cumsum(pca_var_ratio)
#plot(cumu_var)

library(pls)

bank$Attrition_Flag <- as.numeric(bank$Attrition_Flag)-1
pca_mod <- pcr(Attrition_Flag~.,data = bank, scale = TRUE , validation = "CV")
summary(pca_mod)
```

## compare cumulative with cross-validation error
```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(cumu_var)
validationplot(pca_mod, val.type="RMSEP")

cumu_var[18]
```

## จากการพิจารณากราฟ จึงเลือก PCA 18
```{r}
bank_pca <- data.frame(bank$Attrition_Flag, pca$x[,1:18])
bank_pca$bank.Attrition_Flag <- factor(bank_pca$bank.Attrition_Flag, levels = c(0,1))

library(performanceEstimation)
bank_pca <- smote(bank.Attrition_Flag~., data = bank_pca, perc.over = 3.45, perc.under = 1.75)

pca_mod <- glm(bank.Attrition_Flag~.,data = bank_pca, family = "binomial")
```

```{r include=FALSE}
summary(pca_mod)
pca_acc <- 1:20
pca_pre <- 1:20
pca_rec <- 1:20
pca_f1 <- 1:20

pca_tp = seq(20)
pca_tn = seq(20)
pca_fp = seq(20)
pca_fn = seq(20)
pca_pre = seq(20)
pca_rec = seq(20)
pca_f1 = seq(20)


table(bank_pca$bank.Attrition_Flag)
for (i in 1:20){
  train <- sample(dim(bank_pca)[1], size = (0.8*dim(bank_pca)[1]), replace = FALSE)

  pca_mod <- glm(bank.Attrition_Flag~.,data = bank_pca, family = "binomial")
  pca_prob <- predict(pca_mod, newdata= bank_pca[-train,], type = "response")
  pca_pred <- rep(0, length(pca_prob))
  pca_pred[pca_prob > median(pca_prob)] = 1
  pca_acc[i] <- mean(bank_pca[-train, ]$bank.Attrition_Flag == pca_pred)
  pca_table <- table(pca_pred, bank_pca[-train, ]$bank.Attrition_Flag)
  pca_tp[i] <- pca_table[1,1]
  pca_tn[i] <- pca_table[2,2]
  pca_fp[i] <- pca_table[1,2]
  pca_fn[i] <- pca_table[2,1]
  pca_pre[i] <- pca_tp[i]/(pca_tp[i] + pca_fp[i])
  pca_rec[i] <- pca_tp[i]/(pca_tp[i] + pca_fn[i])
  pca_f1[i] <- 2*pca_pre[i]*pca_rec[i]/(pca_pre[i] + pca_rec[i])
}


avg_pca_tp <- mean(pca_tp)
avg_pca_tn <- mean(pca_tn)
avg_pca_fp <- mean(pca_fp)
avg_pca_fn <- mean(pca_fn)

avg_pca_table <- matrix(c(avg_pca_tp, avg_pca_fp, avg_pca_fn, avg_pca_tn), byrow = TRUE, ncol = 2)
colnames(avg_pca_table) <- c("Attrited Customer", "Existing Customer")
rownames(avg_pca_table) <- c("Pred Attrited Customer", "Pred Existing Customer")


avg_pca_acc <- mean(pca_acc)
avg_pca_pre <- mean(pca_pre)
avg_pca_rec <- mean(pca_rec)
avg_pca_f1 <- mean(pca_f1)

pca_auc <- roc.curve(bank_pca[-train,]$bank.Attrition_Flag, pca_pred)$auc

```

```{r}
avg_pca_table
avg_pca_acc
avg_pca_pre
avg_pca_rec
avg_pca_f1

roc.curve(bank_pca[-train,]$bank.Attrition_Flag, pca_pred)$auc

```

## จากผลของ Model ได้ว่า ตัวแปรที่เหมาะสมสำหรับ Model
#### GenderM 

#### Education_LevelDoctorate 
#### Education_LevelPost.Graduate 

#### Income_Category.40K....60K
#### Income_Category.60K....80K  
#### Income_CategoryLess.than..40K    
#### Income_CategoryUnknown 

#### Total_Relationship_Count ยิ่งมีสัมพันธ์ หรือพันธะกับธนาคารมาก ยิ่งส่งเสริม ให้เกิดข้อผูกมันกับทางธนาคารมาก เช่น เช่น สินเชื่อ, เงินฝาก, การลงทุน ทำให้เครดิตของการเป็นลูกค้าบัตรก็จะมีมาก
#### Months_Inactive_12_mon  ลูกค้าลืม ไม่ใช้บัตรนาน เครดิตหมด
#### Contacts_Count_12_mon  ลูกค้ามีปัญหาบ่อยกับธนาคาร
#### Credit_Limit วงเงินสูง อิสระทางการเงินของลูกค้ามีมาก ลูกค้าเกิดข้อผูกมัดกับธนาคารมาก ยิ่งใช้บัตรได้มากเท่าไหร่ ยิ่งมีเครดิตมากเท่านั้น และยิ่งเครดิตมีมาก สิทธิประโยชน์แก่เจ้าของบัตรก็จะมีมาก
#### Avg_Utilization_Ratio   จ่ายยอดเกินวงเงินไม่ครบ ธนาคารไม่ปล่อย
